column3: “Became son-in-law to Ahab” is rendered “allied himself by marriage with Ahab.”
“To the end of years” is rendered “some years later”; NASB supplies “to visit.” “Incited” is rendered “induced.”
NASB supplies “I am” and “we will be.”
“As the day” is rendered “first.”
“Desist” is rendered “refrain.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Not … for good, for all his days for evil” is rendered “never … good … but always evil.” NASB spells “Imla.”
“Court-official” is rendered “officer.”
“Clothed garments” is rendered “arrayed in their robes.”
“Until destroy them” is rendered “until they are consumed.”
NASB supplies “for.”
“A mouth one” is rendered “uniformly,” and “good” as “favorable.”
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew has the short form “Micah” here; NASB writes “Micaiah.” “Desist” is rendered “refrain,” and NASB supplies “for.”
“Until how many times” is rendered “How many times must,” and “make you swear” as “adjure you.”
“Masters” is rendered “master.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
“Deceive” is rendered “entice.” “This one was saying thus and this one was saying thus” is rendered “one said this while another said that.”
“Deceive” is rendered “entice,” and “to it” as “to him.”
“A spirit of falsehood” is rendered “a deceiving spirit,” and “deceive” as “entice.”
“A spirit of falsehood” is rendered “a deceiving spirit”; “spoken on you calamity” is rendered “proclaimed disaster against you.”
“Where is this the way the spirit of Yahweh passed” is rendered “How did the Spirit of the LORD pass.”
“Go a room in a room” is rendered “enter an inner room.”
“Official” is rendered “governor.”
“The house of imprisonment” is rendered “prison,” and “bread of oppression and water of oppression” as “sparingly with bread and water.”
“Peoples, all of them” is rendered “all you people.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Your own clothes” is rendered “your robes.”
“Commanders of the chariotry” is rendered “captains of his chariots.”
